item.title: Gemini Decisions API
item.description: Gemini Decisions API Google join Jev and OpenAI in the decision model category with "Gemini Decision 1". This new model API is almost identical to Jev: it supports the same three types of questions (yes/no, choice, and rubric-scoring) and even reuses Jev's term "Noul" for a yes/no question. It's priced the same as the GPT-6 Luna decision model: 10 cents per million input tokens, and output is free. Jev remains the cheapest of the three, at 4.2 cents per million. Jev is text (and JSON) only. OpenAI can handle text and images. Gemini Decision 1 is fully multi-model: it covers text, images, audio — 来源：google_ai_blog · hackernews · latent_space · deepmind_blog · techcrunch_ai · hn_frontpage — 原文：https://simonwillison.net/2026/Nov/11/gemini-decisions-api/

item.title: Detecting and recovering from silent data corruption on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod
item.description: Silent data corruption is a GPU fault that returns wrong but plausible numbers with no error, quietly poisoning distributed training. item.title: DeNA-SGN: Deterministic Neighborhood Aggregation for Verified Spiking Graph Inference
item.description: Graph learning on neuromorphic substrates requires an explicit spiking realization of neighborhood aggregation, supporting control and classification. We propose DeNA-SGN, which combines fixed OR and tie-inclusive Majority aggregation of binary node features with a learned signed-weight threshold classifier. A degree-dependent inhibitory construction implements Majority through shared control neurons, enabling a complete circuit compilation into SuperNeuroMAT. Across seven datasets and 41 mapped classifiers, native simulation matches the exported ANN on every evaluated class decision and outpu — 来源：aws_ml · arxiv — 原文：https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14775v1
